''See also: [[Void Sage Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Void [[Sage]] is a title held by [[Lindon]], a gifted and highly trained individual who has ascended to the rank of [[Sage]]. His power is fundamentally rooted in his connection to the [[Void Icon]], a source of [[Authority|authority]] centered on the concepts of [[hunger]] and subtraction. This essence allows him to manipulate empty spaces, remove obstacles, and utilize a [[technique]] known as [[Consume]] to steal power. His spiritual makeup is heavily defined by [[hunger madra]], which resonates with the predatory nature of certain environments like [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]]. As a [[Sage]], [[Lindon]] possesses [[Authority|authority]] that can command connections to break or warp the world around him. He has demonstrated the ability to [[construct]] pocket worlds and can cloak himself using the concealment properties of his [[Icon]]. Despite his immense potential and status as a master of [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]], some observers view him as an immature [[Sage]] who has not yet reached the full status of a [[Dreadgod]]. His connection to the Void is so profound that he has explored depths of nonexistence far beyond the reach of most living beings, gaining a reputation for having looked deeper into the Void than anyone else.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Void [[Sage]] is identified as [[Wei Shi Lindon Arelius]] and has [[Kelsa]] as a sister. This entity travels to meet [[Yerin]] and possesses a method to assist her in attacking [[Dreadgods]]. Additionally, [[Dross]] addresses [[Lindon]] by this title, and the entity holds views regarding [[Reigan Shen's Remnant]].}}
